items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: all of them musicians know me from, from Howard, from Kid Howard, Punt, Rene, Chris Kelly

ctx.x: Yeah, all them writing numbers. They never did bother with no. You know what I mean, them classic music. They didn't bother with that. Mighty Pewdie would act for classic music. But now, like, if you're... You see, when you used to go to, when you used to go for a picnic, Well, one place for the, for the colored fellas, well, that's for the decent part. Well, where, where, where they don't, well, then the other part is for us, you understand? For the rooftop. What do I mean, rooftop? We used to rough and dance,…
